5e7590b8a7645e130a2e191a2a1001306870bb9f: Bumbach is a small, low-key resort: 10 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Bumbach's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Bumbach's modest altitude, from 920 m at the base to 1365 m at the top, makes it sensitive to weather variations. January and February remain the most reliable months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before you set off is strongly recommended. At 41€, the day lift pass places Bumbach among the mid-range resorts for budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short: Bumbach doesn't compete with the giants of skiing, and doesn't pretend to. It's an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
